risk_statement: Sensitive data may be disclosed to AI systems or unauthorized users causing privacy contractual or regulatory impact
key_controls: Data minimization; approved tools; DLP; access controls; retention limits; user training
evidence_required: DLP logs; configuration evidence; access reviews; vendor data-use terms

risk_statement: AI may produce confident but unsupported output that is relied upon in a business decision
key_controls: Human verification; retrieval grounding; citations where feasible; test sets; usage boundaries
evidence_required: Evaluation results; sampled outputs; reviewer records; issue log

risk_statement: AI-assisted applicant screening may create or amplify discriminatory outcomes
key_controls: Bias testing; job-related criteria; human decision authority; adverse-impact review; appeal path
evidence_required: Bias evaluation; outcome metrics; reviewer procedures; approval record

risk_statement: Third-party AI provider changes or outages may create unassessed security compliance or continuity risk
key_controls: Vendor due diligence; change notification; SLA; exit plan; subprocessor review
evidence_required: Assessment; contract clauses; service reports; change notices

risk_statement: Prompt injection or retrieval poisoning may manipulate system behavior or expose restricted content
key_controls: Input filtering; retrieval access controls; adversarial testing; content boundaries; logging
evidence_required: Red-team results; access-control tests; logs; remediation records

risk_statement: Users may over-rely on AI recommendations and weaken independent judgment
key_controls: Human oversight standard; training; confidence cues; approval gates; override capability
evidence_required: Training records; workflow evidence; override logs; QA sampling

risk_statement: Insufficient disclosure or explanation may prevent affected people from understanding meaningful AI involvement
key_controls: Disclosure rules; explanation standard; escalation path; documentation

risk_statement: Missing logs or incomplete documentation may prevent reconstruction of AI decisions incidents or model changes
key_controls: Central logging; version records; prompt/output retention by policy; decision records; access logs
evidence_required: Audit logs; version history; model card; approval records

risk_statement: Model or service changes may reduce performance or invalidate prior risk assessment
key_controls: Change control; re-testing triggers; vendor notification; performance monitoring
evidence_required: Change tickets; vendor notices; re-test results; approval records

risk_statement: AI-generated content may create intellectual-property or provenance concerns
key_controls: Approved-use policy; provenance review; human editing; vendor terms; restricted-content controls
evidence_required: Policy; vendor terms; content-review samples; issue log
